data.name: ConfirmBackup_Instructions
data.value: 1. From the menu bar, select File > Backup Configuration. 2. Read the note in the dialog box, and click Backup. 3. Enter a file name for the .cnf file. 4. Enter a folder destination, and click Save. 5. Wait until the backup is finished, and click Close.
